title: try? recovers from operands whose paths throw
purpose: A throwing branch selected by a literal condition, an operand with no successful path (typed by its Maybe<T> boundary or its fallback), match, compact choices, loops, nested handlers and try! keep try? a Maybe<T> that is none on a caught error, with a lazy fallback.

provenance.expected_basis: spec 9.6.1 and Book 14.5: try? is Maybe.some(value), or Maybe.none when evaluating its operand throws an Error; a throw ends its own path, not the try? that handles it.
